title: DIAGNO: Diagonal Spherical Neural Operators for Heterogeneous Earth Dynamics Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.16356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of Earth's dynamic systems is vital in geophysics, where neural operators offer a powerful data-driven paradigm. Standard operators often treat the Earth as a flat Euclidean plane, introducing geometric artifacts. In contrast, Spherical Neural Operators (SNOs) resolve this mismatch by operating within the spherical spectral space, naturally adapting to spherical geometries. However, for computational efficiency, existing SNOs typically rely on the rotation equivariance assumption. This assumption simplifies the transitions of physical states into isolated spectral modal evolutions, thereby over-idealizing the Earth as a homogeneous system. To solve this problem, we no longer rely on the rotation equivariance assumption that isolates spectral modal evolution, but directly derive an explicit modal interaction kernel and propose Diagonal Spherical Neural Operators named DIAGNO. translated_title: DIAGNO：用于非均质地球动力学建模的对角球面神经算子
translated_abstract: 准确预测地球动力系统在地球物理学中至关重要，而神经算子为此提供了一种强大的数据驱动范式。标准算子通常将地球视为平坦的欧几里得平面，从而引入几何伪影。相比之下，球面神经算子（SNOs）通过在球面谱空间中运行来解决这一不匹配问题，能够自然地适应球面几何结构。然而，出于计算效率的考虑，现有的SNOs通常依赖于旋转等变性假设。该假设将物理状态的转变简化为孤立的谱模态演化，从而将地球过度理想化为一个均质系统。为了解决这一问题，我们不再依赖隔离谱模态演化的旋转等变性假设，而是直接推导出显式的模态交互核，并提出了一种名为DIAGNO的对角球面神经算子。DIAGNO显式地参数化跨模态交互。
tldr: 提出对角球面神经算子DIAGNO，通过显式推导模态交互核并参数化谱模态间的交互，突破了现有球面神经算子旋转等变性假设对地球均质性的过度理想化，实现对非均质地球动力系统更准确的建模。
en_tdlr: DIAGNO introduces Diagonal Spherical Neural Operators that explicitly derive a modal interaction kernel to parameterize cross-modal interactions, relaxing the rotation equivariance assumption that over-idealizes the Earth as homogeneous, thereby enabling more accurate modeling of heterogeneous Earth dynamics.
